query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
contact_number as "Contact number",
village as "Village",
billing_type as "Billing type",
to_char(((appointment_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Appointment date and time",
to_char(((appointment_end_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Appointment end date and time",
appointment_type as "Appointment type",
appointment_status as "Appointment status",
clinician as "Clinician",
location_group as "Area",
priority as "Priority appointment",
case
when schedule_id notnull then concat(
concat(
case when "interval" = 1 then
case frequency
when 'WEEKLY' then 'Weekly on a '
when 'MONTHLY' then 'Monthly on the '
end
else concat('Every ', "interval",
case frequency
when 'WEEKLY' then ' weeks on '
when 'MONTHLY' then ' months on the '
end
)
end
),
case nth_weekday
when -1 then 'last '
when 1 then 'first '
when 2 then 'second '
when 3 then 'third '
when 4 then 'fourth ' 
else ''
end,
array_to_string(
array(select case unnest_day
when 'MO' then 'Monday'
when 'TU' then 'Tuesday'
when 'WE' then 'Wednesday'
when 'TH' then 'Thursday'
when 'FR' then 'Friday'
when 'SA' then 'Saturday'
when 'SU' then 'Sunday'
else unnest_day
end from unnest(days_of_week) as unnest_day),
', '
)
)
else 'No'
end as "Repeating appointment",
to_char(until_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Repeating appointment end date",
created_by as "Appointment created by"
from "reporting"."ds__outpatient_appointments"
where ((appointment_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) >= 
:fromDate
and
((appointment_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) <= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:locationGroupId is null then true
else location_group_id = 
:locationGroupId
end
and
case
when coalesce(
:appointmentStatus) is null then true
else appointment_status in (
:appointmentStatus)
end
and
case
when 
:clinicianId is null then true
else clinician_id = 
:clinicianId
end
and
case
when 
:appointmentTypeId is null then true
else appointment_type_id = 
:appointmentTypeId
end
order by appointment_start_datetime
name: Outpatient appointments line list
notes: This report generates a list of all patients with a scheduled appointment for the selected parameters. Patients are listed in chronological order by date and time of scheduled appointment
